data_output.description: feature_engineer must update data.py to derive only tab, hour, and weekday from impression-time request context available in the raw logs, without using labels or post-impression fields. Preserve every split's original source row order and preserve the existing user_id and video_id features. Build categorical vocabularies from training rows only; map unseen validation/test values to per-field unknown buckets. Return encoded features containing user_id, video_id, tab, hour, and weekday in that fixed order, labels only for training/early stopping as required by the existing training interface, and validation user identifiers. trainer must emit the fixed output artifact predictions_valid.npz with exactly two arrays: row_ids and scores. row_ids must equal int64 arange of the validation-row count in canonical validation source order, and scores must be a one-dimensional finite array aligned positionally with row_ids. No ground-truth validation file or evaluator metric may be used to construct the artifact; the fixed evaluator alone owns final ground-truth loading and scoring.

model_input.description: model.py remains unchanged: Model receives the encoded feature dimension, sums additive weights for each feature index, trains with the existing BCE/Adam-like step, and predicts one logit score per validation row. trainer must keep all existing hyperparameters and config values unchanged, except any required dimension inferred from the expanded data encoding. The fixed command must continue to support --config, --data-dir, --output, and --contract-check, and contract-check must verify finite one-dimensional predictions and exact validation alignment.
